SPIDER SWING - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft).
Code MIT; art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

Run SpiderSwing.exe. No installation or extra DLLs needed.

Tap gamepad A (keyboard X or Z, also C/V) to RELEASE your current web.
The spider keeps its momentum. Release while swinging upward toward the
sparkling flower, then hold LEFT / RIGHT to steer and aim in the air.
The loose silk follows your spider and stays visible throughout flight. Steer
the strand into any higher flower: touching it attaches immediately, with a
sparkle and catch sound. You do not need to put the spider's body on the flower.
Directions alone do not release a web. Holding A does not repeatedly release.
Flowers score 10; dewdrops add 3. Five flower shapes come in pink, lilac and
amber; each shape plays its own musical note when caught, so your catches form
a little melody as you climb. Bees patrol the outside lanes later in the run.
Your flower wilts if you wait too long: seven seconds at first, five
seconds later. One life, an endless climb, and a saved best score to beat.

A / X starts from the title. Enter starts, pauses and resumes.
Backspace / Esc / Right Shift also pause. After results, A returns to the title.
Players 2-4 join with A on the title and leave with B. P1 starts the game.
Each player has an independent camera. P2 keyboard: H releases/joins, G leaves
on the title, A/D steer in flight, T Start, R Select. Up to four gamepads work.
F11 or Alt+Enter toggles fullscreen. F12 takes a screenshot.
Best scores are saved to spiderswing.srm next to the executable.
